In a market where there is an oversupply of labor a business owner has the upper hand in determining wages. There is also the notion that wealth tends to concentrate (see Thomas Piketty) making it more difficult in a truly free market society to achieve more wealth when you're already at the bottom. (The idea that when you do more business with the bank they give you lower and lower rates)

So we know there is a limited amount of money to give which is why we can't set the minimum wage too high. We also don't want to depress the economy and we want to give people a living wage so we don't set it too low.
